newsitem.title: USA: EA Industries says sells Aydin shrs.
newsitem.headline: EA Industries says sells Aydin shrs.

text.p: EA Industries Inc said Wednesday it sold 500,000 shares of Aydin Corp stock for about $5.4 million to a group of investors.
EA said it sold the stock at $10.75 per share

EA also said it granted an option to the group, which it said was introduced to the company by the chairman of Aydin, on the 96,927 remaining shares of Aydin it holds, to be exercised by October 1 at an price of $10.75 per share.
EA received proceeds of about $3.3 million after paying off loans secured by the Aydin stock.
The company said it agreed to provide consulting services to Aydin for three years to help it solicit customers internationally and explore strategic joint ventures.
In exchange for the services, EA said it received a warrant to buy 167,524 Aydin shares, half at an exercise price of $12.10 per share and half at $13.20 per share.
EA Industries, through its Tanon Manufacturing Inc subsidiary, is a manufacturing company that focuses on the electronics industry.
